summary: Audax Credit BDC Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its Board of Directors declared an ordinary quarterly cash distribution of $0.16 per share on September 25, 2026. The distribution is payable September 29, 2026 to holders of record on September 28, 2026; the short record-to-payment window is typical for a BDC declaring a regular distribution. No advisor, premium, tender, merger, or strategic action is disclosed. The filing is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies, though BDC distribution coverage and NAV trends remain the monitoring focus.
